title: uRDF deterministic template QA catalogue
description: Closed template catalogue for deterministic question answering over Node-RED application, inferred, and imported knowledge graphs.

validationFailureText.missingParameter: Invalid request: parameter "{parameterName}" is required for templateId "{templateId}".
validationFailureText.invalidEnumValue: Invalid request: parameter "{parameterName}" must be one of: {allowedValues}.
validationFailureText.emptyString: Invalid request: parameter "{parameterName}" must be a non-empty string.
validationFailureText.wrongType: Invalid request: parameter "{parameterName}" must be a string.
validationFailureText.unexpectedParameter: Invalid request: parameter "{parameterName}" is not allowed for templateId "{templateId}".

notes: The sample GitHub import graph contains issue and pull-request URLs, but the provided project files do not expose a clean RDF-level split between issues and pull requests.
V1 therefore treats every https://schema.org/DigitalDocument in urn:graph:issues as an imported issue record.

sections.emptyBullet: - No warning comment was found in the inferred graph.

subjectHeadingsByTemplate.matching.show_community_flow_matches_for: Imported community flows matched to flow {displayLabel}:

entitySelection.flagCondition: an application entity is flagged if the inferred graph contains at least one literal schema:comment triple whose subject IRI equals the entity @id

intermediateRecordShape.flowName: linked flow schema:name literal or '-' for nodes

textMapping.multipleResults: render one heading followed by one bullet per intermediate record

reasonCollection.rule: collect all literal schema:comment values from inferred graph for each matched entity subject; deduplicate exact strings; sort case-insensitively ascending

relatedKnowledgeCounts.joinRule: for each matched entity subject, collect inferred schema:seeAlso target IRIs, then count unique targets that exist as @id in each imported source graph

textMapping.perMatch: render one subject block for each matched entity in sorted order

nodeOnlyFields: nrua:isPartOfFlow followed by linked flow schema:name
detailCollection.sameAsDisplayRule: for each inferred schema:sameAs target IRI, render the linked entity display label when the target exists in the application graph; otherwise render the target IRI

relatedKnowledgeCounts.joinRule: for each matched entity subject, collect inferred schema:seeAlso target IRIs, then count unique targets that exist as @id in each imported source graph

textMapping.perMatch: render one subject block per matched entity using the section set for the entity kind

joinAndFilter.joinRule: for each matched entity subject, collect inferred schema:seeAlso target IRIs, keep only targets whose @id exists in one of the included source graphs, deduplicate by target @id within each source

textMapping.perMatch: render one subject block per matched entity; for each included source render the configured section heading followed by bullets or '- None.'

selection.matchRule: an application flow is included if the inferred graph contains at least one schema:seeAlso target IRI for that flow and that target exists as @id in the communityFlows source graph

joinAndFilter.joinRule: for each matched flow subject, collect inferred schema:seeAlso target IRIs, keep only targets whose @id exists in the communityFlows source graph, deduplicate by target @id

textMapping.perMatch: render one subject block per matched flow with only the Community flows section

countRule.issues: count graph nodes in urn:graph:issues whose rdf:type includes https://schema.org/DigitalDocument
countRule.forum: count graph nodes in urn:graph:forum whose rdf:type includes https://schema.org/DigitalDocument
countRule.communityFlows: count graph nodes in urn:graph:flowslib whose rdf:type includes https://schema.org/SoftwareSourceCode

textMapping.multipleResults: render one heading followed by one bullet per matching imported record

Show all imported knowledge linked to a named node or flow, grouped by issues, forum posts, and community flows.
List application flows that have inferred matches to imported community flows.
Show imported community flows matched to a named application flow.
Count imported issues, forum posts, or community flows inside their source graph.
List imported issues, forum posts, or community flows whose schema:title contains the given topic substring, case-insensitively.
